rationale: The assistant went straight to the right first check (inspect the freezer door seal and where ice forms), correctly identified the split/flattened gasket as the likely cause once the customer reported it, and recommended the door seal only after damage was confirmed and the model number IB55532W was obtained, explicitly refusing to confirm a catalogue match ('I cannot confirm a catalogue match for that exact model reference'). Safety guidance was sound (unplug, no knife on the liner, full defrost first). Minor weaknesses: the opening mention of an automatic-defrost fault sat slightly oddly with a customer who manually defrosts, and the final reply restated the alignment check and likely-cause statement already made, but neither impeded progress.
